svg.text: Route: /admin/analytics · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin only (admin site, signed in)
• Daily / Weekly / Monthly changes the sales chart and the Revenue, Orders and Average order value tiles (last 14 days / 8 weeks / 6 months). Average order value = revenue ÷ paid orders
(“—” with none); the chart's hover shows each period's revenue, orders and average. Top products, profitability and movement are all-time; Needs restock is right now.
• The sales export (CSV, Excel, PDF) has an Average order value column.
• Each card exports its report as CSV, Excel or PDF (GET /api/reports/export). Empty states: “No sales in this period” (with “Try a longer period above.”), “No sales yet”, and “No products
have a cost recorded yet — add one in Products to see margins here.”

g.text: Right now · at or below minimum
Inventory movement · sold all time, stock now
